about: Five test users for the test tenant. Made-up people only: no real names, addresses or gate codes (DESIGN.md section 3, constraint 1). Logins use the reserved .test domain, so none can reach a real inbox. See docs/TEST-USERS.md.

users.name: Old Man Stevens

persona.quote: Old Man Stevens gets big buttons and one green light.

users.wants: To know if the grandkids can swim today, and to call someone if not.
users.breaksIf: He sees a number he has to interpret, or a button smaller than his thumb.
checks: Status reads from arm's length in direct sun
Calling the company takes one tap
No chemistry words: 'chlorine is fine', never 'FC 3.1'

users.name: The tech-savvy kid

persona.quote: The tech-savvy kid gets automation and data.

users.wants: Every reading, the math behind it, and alerts that fire without asking.
users.breaksIf: Numbers are rounded, the source of a reading is hidden, or there is no export.
checks: Each reading shows who took it and how (drop test, strip, photo)
An alert rule saves and fires once on seeded test data
CSV export opens in a spreadsheet unchanged

users.name: The pool guy
users.device: Pixel in a wet case, gloves, noon sun
users.wants: Readings in, doses out, next stop, without slowing down.
users.breaksIf: A control needs two hands or the screen washes out in sun.
checks: A stop takes under 60 seconds with one thumb (DESIGN.md M3)
Every dose names the product and its strength

users.name: Seasonal new hire

persona.quote: An under-qualified seasonal hire with a phone, a plain test kit and the right app can service pools competently, with a senior tech rotating for quality checks.

users.wants: To be told the next step and to know when to ask.
users.breaksIf: The app assumes they know what TA or CYA means.
checks: Every step says what to do with the kit in hand
A dose over the safety ceiling waits for the senior's OK
'Ask a senior' reaches someone from any screen

users.name: Owner

persona.quote: The numbers that tell an owner whether the business is healthy.

users.device: Phone in the truck, laptop at night
users.wants: Stops per day, time on site and chemical cost, each with its formula.
users.breaksIf: A number appears without the records behind it.
checks: Every KPI shows its formula and record count (DESIGN.md M12)
Tenant test-01 cannot read another tenant's rows (DESIGN.md M4)
A 'liner: poor' flag opens exactly one quote (DESIGN.md M9)
